items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Yeah, Simeon was the only one I can remember on the clarinet.

ctx.x: one of them, Someday Sweetheart. Simeon, when I talked to him, he told me he played a bass clarinet. I'd forgotten it. It was a real low, big bass clarinet on that. And it had some violins. Do you remember? Or one violin, anyway, on that one number, Someday Sweetheart. Oh, no, I can't remember that. Maybe I wasn't going to... Yeah, I think so, but maybe you forgot. I can't remember. I can't remember the violin. The violin. You don't remember but the one clarinet? No, I don't remember, but the one clarinet, that's…
of the clarinet by himself. Yeah, Simeon was very good. He was very good. Yeah, Simeon was the only one I can remember on the clarinet. Simeon and he only had one trumpet. Or did
you ever use a mute in those days much? Like on those jelly records? Did you? Let's see.
